verdict.rationale: Outlook is an email client, so AI-drafted replies in the user's own voice is a fair axis. However, the pack has no evidence of an AI reply-drafting feature, let alone one that matches personal tone. The Graph API's ability to draft and reply to messages is a developer building block, and the single community mention of 'Copilot integration' in Outlook never says it drafts replies or adapts to the user's voice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate
